title: Junior Designer - Kuwaiti National Only
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Junior Designer – Motion Graphics, Kuwait Marketing Team


Please note we can only accept applications from Kuwaiti nationals for this role.

Why Deliveroo?

When you first think about Deliveroo, you probably think of getting great food delivered to your door in less than half an hour. But behind the scenes, there is a bigger story: one of high growth, exciting challenges, and a huge opportunity ahead.

We want to be the definitive food company — the app people turn to whenever they have a hunger pang. We are transforming the way people think about food and building a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing industries in the world. Join us for the ride.


About the role

We are looking for a Junior Designer with a strong focus on motion graphics to support the Kuwait marketing team across all campaigns. This role will be hands-on, fast-paced, and highly collaborative, working closely with the local marketing team, brand team, and wider creative stakeholders to deliver engaging visual assets for campaign, social, CRM, and owned-channel activity.

The main responsibility of this role will be to support the development of motion graphics and design assets that bring Deliveroo campaigns to life in a way that feels fresh, on-brand, and locally relevant for the Kuwait market.


Objectives of this role

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with a high-volume workload and short turnaround times.

  • Support the Kuwait marketing team with creative design and motion graphics across campaigns, always delivering work that is on-brand and visually engaging.

  • Help raise the standard of visual storytelling across marketing channels through strong motion design, layout, and creative execution.

  • Interpret briefs clearly and translate campaign objectives into compelling visual assets.

  • Stay up to date with design, motion, social, and digital content trends, especially those relevant to the Kuwait market.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of Deliveroo’s brand guidelines, visual identity, and campaign style.

Responsibilities

  • Support the Kuwait marketing team across all campaigns with design and motion graphics requirements.

  • Create motion graphics for marketing campaigns, social media, CRM, owned channels, digital placements, and other campaign touchpoints.

  • Interpret creative briefs and develop visual concepts that align with campaign objectives.

  • Adapt campaign assets across different formats, channels, and audience needs.

  • Work closely with the marketing and brand teams to ensure all visual assets are consistent with Deliveroo’s brand identity.

  • Create static and animated assets using Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma.

  • Support the localisation of campaign visuals for the Kuwait market.

  • Take feedback from stakeholders and revise creative work quickly and accurately.

  • Organise and manage design files, templates, and campaign assets efficiently.

  • Stay current with emerging design tools, AI-enabled creative workflows, and motion graphics best practices.

Required skills and qualifications

  • At least 1 year of experience in a corporate, agency, or in-house creative environment.

  • A strong portfolio showcasing both motion and static graphics work.

  • Good working knowledge of Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop.

  • Knowledge of Figma and experience adapting designs across digital formats.

  • Strong understanding of visual design principles, layout, typography, colour, and composition.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects at once.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to deliver polished work within tight deadlines.

  • A proactive attitude and willingness to learn, experiment, and improve.

Preferred skills and qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in graphic design, motion design, visual communication, multimedia design, or a related creative field.

  • Experience working on marketing campaigns, social media content, or digital advertising assets.

  • Knowledge of AI creative tools and how they can support design, production, or workflow efficiency.

  • Experience working with local or regional Middle East brands is a plus.

  • Interest in food, culture, social trends, and digital content.

Benefits and Diversity

  • 30 days of annual leave

  • Medical insurance

  • Free Deliveroo Plus — free delivery and access to special offers

  • Maternity and paternity benefits

  • End-of-year parties and regular social events

  • An extremely fun team to work with

At Deliveroo, we know that people are the heart of the business, and we prioritise their welfare. We offer many great benefits across health, family, finance, community, convenience, growth, time away, and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any of the things that make you who you are — your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for most food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing companies around.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.
